answer: The willow escrow is released only against a pigment receipt, and the sparrow audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 28 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 142 aliases means carrying 231 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
